graph_surfaces.statement: This repository carries two graph surfaces. They are distinct and neither replaces the other.

intent_work_graph.kind: persistent authority-routed intent and work graph
intent_work_graph.authored_by: an Owner-adopted decision carried by a bounded packet
intent_work_graph.role: states intended Product 2 state and what work advances it; a Director hydrates it before dispatch

derived_engineering_graph.kind: derived observation of Issues, branches, pull requests, reviews, merges, deployments and evidence
derived_engineering_graph.authored_by: the builder, from a frozen observation of live GitHub
derived_engineering_graph.role: reports what has actually happened; it is an index, never an authority source

graph_surfaces.separation: The derived projection is not deleted, merged into, or reinterpreted by this manifest. Intended state is never inferred from the projection, and observed state is never asserted by this manifest. A contradiction between them is reported, never averaged.

product_1_relation.note: This is the only cross-contour relation. Product 1 holds its own north star, its own goal graph, its own authority and its own graph memory in its own repositories. No node, edge, decision, admitted action or state update in this manifest is a Product 1 record, and this manifest cannot decide anything for Product 1.

not_implemented_at_this_stage: enforcement: no runtime reads this manifest to admit or refuse a session; the Owner launch line and the packet grammar remain the only gate

reconciliation: no reconciler compares this manifest with live GitHub state; drift between intended state here and observed state in the derived engineering projection is invisible to the machine and must be read by a human at hydration time
durable event accumulation: no append-only ledger exists in this repository; the exact pull request head, check output and terminal RESULT remain external execution evidence
STARTED events: no persisted STARTED event store exists, so no node in this manifest is marked running; a node may only be described as PENDING until such an event is persisted
external runtimes: none is named here; when one is, it is admitted only as a replaceable executor outside the control-plane trust boundary

edges.claim: Operating the construction business AI-natively on an owner-controlled multi-level graph is what makes the north star real rather than declared.
A public surface that stays inside what is actually supported keeps the business real; an overstated surface would falsify the north star rather than advance it.
The multi-level work graph is the substrate of the AI-native operating platform; this module builds its intent side first-party in the adopted contract.

A Director cannot dispatch against an empty graph. This packet seeds the first live Product 2 path, makes it machine-traversable, and binds the Director to hydrate it before dispatch. Its containment in module.product-2-graph-control-plane is its parent scope, which is how the adopted contract expresses membership: an ADVANCES edge ends on a live GOAL.
Intended state that is never compared with observed state decays into a second memory. Reconciliation keeps the two surfaces distinct and honest about their differences.

The alignment record this Work Node reconciles was adopted by the Owner and exists in merged main at the pinned base revision, byte-resolvable by the recorded digest. This claim covers the authority basis only; this Work Node's own terminal result is PENDING and no evidence for it exists yet.
The NORTH_STAR statement adopted here is the frozen product canon's own section A1 text at the recorded revision, not a paraphrase authored by a session.

contract_note_on_edges: The adopted contract refuses ADVANCES_ENDPOINT_TYPE for an ADVANCES edge that ends on a MODULE_SUBGRAPH: intended state lives on goals, so ADVANCES always terminates on a live GOAL. Module membership is therefore the parent scope chain (work.parent = module, module.parent = outcome, outcome.parent = north_star), and the full NORTH_STAR -> OUTCOME -> MODULE_SUBGRAPH -> WORK_NODE -> EVIDENCE chain is present as: OUTCOME ADVANCES NORTH_STAR, MODULE ADVANCES OUTCOME, WORK ADVANCES OUTCOME inside MODULE by parent scope, EVIDENCE PROVES WORK. One DEPENDS_ON is declared because one real gate exists. No SUPERSEDES is declared: nothing here replaces anything.
contract_note_on_expected_evidence: This packet's own evidence is declared as evidence_expectation with state EXPECTED_NOT_YET_EXISTING on its Work Node, not minted as an EVIDENCE node. The packet brief asks for an expected EVIDENCE node; the pinned contract refuses an evidence node without an exact 40-hex revision and sha256 digest of something that already exists. The conflict is named rather than resolved by widening the vocabulary: the expectation is declared where the contract admits it, and the two EVIDENCE nodes present are the ones that genuinely resolve today.
